What We Offer

Six Core Services

Every service Digha offers is designed to keep Nigerian hospitals running — affordably, reliably and fast.

01
🏗️
X-Ray Room Installation & Commissioning

We supply, install and fully commission X-ray machines and radiological equipment in hospital facilities across Nigeria. We handle everything — room shielding, column installation, table setup, control booth wiring and final calibration.

  • Full radiology room design & setup
  • Lead shielding & radiation protection
  • Static, portable & dual-column systems
  • Control console installation & calibration
  • Post-installation testing & sign-off
Get a quote →
Completed X-ray room · Digha Biomedical
Field repair & maintenance · Digha engineer on-site
02
🔧
Equipment Repair & Maintenance

Rapid-response maintenance for biomedical equipment breakdowns. Digha restores hospital operations quickly — reducing costly downtime with reliable, affordable repair solutions.

  • Emergency breakdown response
  • X-ray tube & generator repair
  • Control board & circuit diagnosis
  • Ultrasound machine servicing
  • Preventive maintenance contracts
  • Spare parts sourcing & supply
Book a repair →
03
⚙️
Biomedical Equipment Manufacturing

Digha designs and manufactures its own biomedical and electronic equipment in-house — all Quality Guaranteed and built to last.

  • X-ray control consoles (DMX-650)
  • Ray combiners & switching units
  • Hybrid solar pump controllers
  • Automatic phase transfer switches
  • Digital & analogue PCB design
  • Custom equipment to specification
Enquire about custom orders →

🔬
Medical Equipment Supply & Procurement

Digha sources and supplies a wide range of medical imaging and diagnostic equipment for hospitals — at competitive, hospital-friendly prices with after-sales support included.

  • Ultrasound machines (colour Doppler)
  • Gynecological examination chairs
  • Hospital diagnostic equipment
  • Imaging accessories & consumables
  • Equipment demos before purchase
  • After-sales support included

🎓
Biomedical Engineering Training

Hands-on biomedical engineering training programs run in partnership with state governments, MedShare and international organisations. 75% practical, 25% theory.

  • 75% hands-on practical sessions
  • Ventilator installation & troubleshooting
  • X-ray machine operation & servicing
  • Electronic component identification
  • State government-certified programs
  • Partnered with MedShare & partners

How It Works

Our Service Process

01
Contact & Assessment

Reach out by phone, WhatsApp or email. We assess your hospital's needs — equipment requirements, room dimensions, budget and timeline.

02
Proposal & Agreement

We provide a detailed proposal covering equipment specs, installation plan, costs and warranty. Once agreed, we get to work immediately.

03
Delivery & Installation

Equipment is delivered and installed by our certified engineers. Room shielding, cabling and all ancillary systems are set up professionally.

04
Testing & Handover

Full system testing, staff orientation and official handover. Ongoing maintenance support begins immediately after commissioning.
